constraints: Use SQL Server 2025 compatibility170 with JsonContains path/search-mode options and understand when nullable collection membership retains OPENJSON.
EF11 requires net11.0. EF10 comparison is not a supported target10 edition or a ninth foundation. No older engine, cloud identity, performance, JSON indexes or GA EF11 verification is claimed.
Actual combined samples require SQL2025 native json columns. SQL8116 rejected nvarchar(max) JSON_CONTAINS on 17.0.5035.5 despite official character-input wording; no textual-column containment claim.
prerequisites: Copy every file of one complete project into its own directory. Install its pinned SDK/runtime and restore locked packages online; serving this recipe remains offline.

The complete sample creates dbo.FieldNotes and sets compatibility170 in an empty, exclusively owned disposable playbook_ database. Supply PLAYBOOK_SQL_CONNECTION_STRING privately; never log it or use production.

The repository authoring helper reuses the authorized PIN-676 SQL container, creates/removes a unique restricted database per release, and stops the server afterwards. External users must arrange their own isolated test database.
optIns: Explicit local #pragma warning disable EF9106 around JsonContains calls; accept possible API change/removal.
stabilityLimitations: Pinned EF11 RC2 marks JsonContains experimental with EF9106; its CLR result is int, although SQL can return NULL. JsonPathExists is not marked experimental. SQL2025 JSON_CONTAINS documentation has no preview label. These are separate API/server stability boundaries; no actual EF11 GA verification.

sources.title: EF Core 11: JSON containment and nullable membership

evidence.scope: Actual isolated SQL2025/170 queries: missing/null/empty nested fields, numeric containment, explicit LIKE mode, missing path/SQL NULL results, non-null primitive membership and nullable column membership. EF10 custom built-in mappings and OPENJSON; EF11 built-in APIs and JSON_CONTAINS with nullable OPENJSON fallback. eng/Test-JsonDocuments.ps1 -Record owns setup and cleanup; RC2 is not GA.
